summary.text: Courtney King is the Democratic candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Chad Puryear.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she listed environmental stewardship and conservation, education and youth empowerment, and rural revitalization and community wellness as her key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: King said her environmental priorities include protecting forests, rivers, lakes and public lands and supporting clean water and sustainable land use.
On education, she said she would invest in public schools and rural educators and expand hands-on arts and STEAM education.

She also listed broadband, transportation and rural infrastructure, mental health access, housing affordability and health care access among her goals, and named equity, access and inclusion as a policy area she is passionate about.
